notes.title: Sandara will be at Save & Sound! Come watch our live concert
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce that [b]Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipsese[/b] will be at Save & Sound on the 5th of November at 10 AM PST and 7 PM CET.

We’ll be participating in the music festival with [b]a cozy concert[/b] performed by [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/7AyyDhDFJbQUqmbyswOXbv?si=YuERRNzLSCaDT8Yp9fswbg]Mira Aasma[/url], [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/3zVDpnuUhxYYCYyTccvdTY?si=4He9s1__RwqOwXfwU1ciNA]Elin Piel[/url], and [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/0L6bI55eofCOZ3RkkrZ5UX?si=yKW4ub-OTkmAB2g__btPPA]Osama Derbas[/url] featuring [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3187920/Sandara_Soundtrack]the original soundtrack of Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses[/url].

Save & Sound is an online music festival with sales and demos on Steam. Celebrate headbanging soundtracks as well as unique implementations of music and audio in games.

You can watch the showcase on Bedtime Digital Games’ channels: [list] 
[*] Twitch: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg]https://www.twitch.tv/bedtimedg[/url] 
[*] YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/@BedtimeDG]https://www.youtube.com/@BedtimeDG[/url]
[/list]
We’re excited to share some good music and good times with you. Check out the new trailer for Save & Sound 2024 below!


[previewyoutube=Kud112cK49c;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you enjoy the festival and see you when it goes live on November 4th! Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/SaveSound2024]festival Steam page[/url] that goes live at 10 AM PST and 7 PM CET.

notes.title: Collect cards to create synergies!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050443/3e2cc48d4f77199cda48dc76d393aa9586cecc40.png[/img]
After some workshopping, we have arrived at what we believe is the most enjoyable part of a deck-builder: creating synergies between cards! 

In the new design, you as the player will be able to collect cards that create beneficial synergies between them. We are looking forward to having you playtest the beta and provide us with your feedback.

What do you look forward to in the beta testing?🌞

[h3]Join closed beta[/h3]
Help us improve Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses by joining our closed playtest. Use the [url=https://subscribepage.io/D4A7QO]link[/url] to visit the landing page of Sandara: City of a Thousand Eclipses and enter your email to be considered for the beta in future invitation rounds.
